 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan, Through The Public Prosecutor
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Cs Rajpurohit.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Surendra Bishnoi, Pp.
 Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Sandeep Shah
Order 08/10/2025
1.

This application for bail under Section 483 B.N.S.S. has been filed by the applicant, who has been
arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.114/2024 registered at Police Station Rajgarh, District Churu
for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 408 and 120-B of Ipc.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the offences alleged are triable by the Magistrate.
He further submits that no recovery of either the chemical or the amount in question has been made from the applicant and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

He also asserts that the truck driven by the applicant, in which the chemical was loaded, caught fire and thereafter, only to claim the benefit of insurance, the applicant has (Uploaded on 08/10/2025 at 06:51:34 PM)
[2025:RJ-JD:44076] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-11157/2025] been falsely implicated.
He, therefore, prays that the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-applicant.

4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the applicant along with co-accused Sandeep sold part of the chemical, while the remaining quantity was kept in the truck.
He further asserts that the GPS device was manipulated by the applicant during the commission of the offence, therefore, the applicant is not entitled to the benefit of bail.

1 5.

Having considered the rival submissions and the facts and circumstances of the case, as well as the fact that the offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate, the petitioner has been in custody since from 01.09.2025 and no recovery of the chemical or the amount in question has been made,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
6. Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 B.N.S.S. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-applicant Sodha Ram S/o Narayan Ram arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.114/2024 registered at Police Station Rajgarh, District Churu shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(Uploaded on 08/10/2025 at 06:51:34 PM)
7. It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

(SANDEEP SHAH),J 172-Jitender/-
